new_player.message: Welcome to Sky Survival! Everything you need is in the chest. Do not fall!

meta.notes: How the world starts: a World Type called Sky Survival of empty sky (void), listed on the Create New World screen, with the island msm_sample_game_modes:sky_survival/island, placed with its corner at 0 64 0 when the first player joins, the spawn on its grass. Players start in survival on normal difficulty; each new player gets a welcome and ten seconds of slow falling, once. The welcome names the goals tab. Mobs spawn on what players build, as on plains (the sky biome of the game kits); the Nether is as normal. Everything lowers to plain data pack files. Each new player also gets a kit of three bread, once (added to the flow's answers for the fixture).
